units.source_text: 他把日来宫中花宴情状讲给紫姬听，又教她弹琴，相伴了一天。

en.t: He told Lady Murasaki about the recent flower banquet at court, taught her to play the koto, and spent the whole day with her.

units.source_text: 到了晚上，公子准备出门，紫姬噘起嘴说：“又要去了。”

en.t: When evening came, the young lord prepared to go out, and Lady Murasaki pouted and said, "You are going again."

units.source_text: 然而近来她已习惯，并不任情阻挠。

en.t: Lately, however, she had grown used to it and did not let her feelings make her stand in his way.
